newsitem.title: CHINA: China gold output 9.9 tonnes in April.
newsitem.headline: China gold output 9.9 tonnes in April.

text.p: China's gold output was 9.9 tonnes in April, bringing combined production in the first four months of the year to 35 tonnes, the China Daily said on Thursday.
Output in the first four months accounted for 35 percent of the target for the whole of 1997 and was an increase of 20 percent over the year-ago period, the newspaper said.
An official of the production division of the Gold Bureau under the Ministry of Metallurgical Industry was quoted as saying gold output this year would exceed its target of 100 tonnes.
China's gold production last year was 120.6 tonnes, up nearly 12 percent from 1995. China has said it aims to raise annual gold production to 150 tonnes by the turn of the century.
The newspaper said the government reduced the price at which it purchases gold to $10.84 per gram from $11.45 per gram this year in a bid to integrate domestic gold prices with international prices.
